title: UE-initiated authentication and key agreement procedure accepted by the network

entities.name: UE-initiated authentication and key agreement procedure
entities.description: Authentication procedure for 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay initiated by UE and accepted by network using EAP-AKA' authentication.

entities.name: RELAY KEY REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent to AMF to initiate relay authentication procedure.

entities.name: RELAY AUTHENTICATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message created by AMF containing EAP request for UE authentication.

entities.name: RELAY AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE
entities.description: Message created by UE containing EAP response from remote UE.

entities.name: RELAY KEY ACCEPT
entities.description: Message sent by AMF indicating successful authentication and containing relay key parameters.

entities.name: PRTI IE
entities.description: ProSe Relay Transaction Identifier information element used to correlate relay authentication messages.

entities.name: EAP message IE
entities.description: Extensible Authentication Protocol message information element carrying authentication payload.

entities.name: relay key response parameters IE
entities.description: Information element containing Key KNR_ProSe and nonce_2 for relay security.

entities.name: Timer T35xx
entities.description: Timer used by UE during relay authentication procedure.

entities.name: Authentication successful
entities.description: Condition when AUSF indicates successful authentication of the relay.

relations.description: Procedure starts with receiving RELAY KEY REQUEST message.
RELAY AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message contains PRTI IE.
RELAY AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message contains EAP message IE.
RELAY AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE message contains PRTI IE.
RELAY AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE message contains EAP message IE.
RELAY KEY ACCEPT message contains PRTI IE.
RELAY KEY ACCEPT message contains EAP message IE.
RELAY KEY ACCEPT message contains relay key response parameters IE.
Receiving RELAY AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message stops timer T35xx.
Sending RELAY AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE message starts timer T35xx.
Successful authentication condition triggers creation of RELAY KEY ACCEPT message.
